spec.title: Sonos Network Overview
spec.description: SonosNet mesh health from the sonos-exporter: reachability, link quality, radio state, traffic and battery.

spec.title: Zones up
spec.description: Players reachable (ICMP when enabled, otherwise seen in the last scrape)

spec.title: Exporter scrape
spec.description: Result of the last /support/review fetch. FAILED means every other panel shows stale values.

spec.title: Data age
spec.description: Seconds since the last successful exporter scrape, as seen through the Prometheus scrape. Orange above 10 minutes.

spec.title: Weakest link per zone
spec.description: Lowest SonosNet FROM quality a zone has towards any peer. Below 40 is a weak mesh link.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Seconds since the player booted. Orange when under a day, i.e. a recent reboot.

spec.title: Software versions
spec.description: More than one row means an update is pending or stuck somewhere

spec.title: Topology
spec.description: SonosNet mesh as reported by each player. Edge value is the FROM link quality, node ring is green when the player is up.

spec.title: Link asymmetry |FROM − TO|
spec.description: Large differences point to a one-sided problem such as interference near one player

spec.title: Wired & bridge
spec.description: Wired players are the roots of the SonosNet mesh

spec.title: WiFi mode
spec.description: One row per zone and mode. A zone that changes mode shows up as two rows.

spec.title: Busy flags
spec.description: Radio busy-client flags as reported by the player (AUDIO_OUT, NO_PRIMARY, ...). A row is present while the flag is set.

spec.title: PHY error rate
spec.description: PHY errors per second. The player counter resets on its own, rate() handles that. 15m window so it works with 5m scrapes.

spec.title: Bandwidth br0 (RX above, TX below zero)
Noise floor
spec.description: Average over RF chains. Only older Atheros based players (Play:1, Play:3, Play:5 gen 1, ...) report this.

spec.title: OFDM ANI level
spec.description: Adaptive noise immunity level of the Atheros radio. Higher means the radio is fighting interference. Only older players report this.

spec.title: Links from this zone
spec.description: Solid: FROM quality, dashed: TO quality
